item.name: Ability Teacher
item.overview: The Ability Teacher is located at the Frozen Village and the Magma Village.

item.name: Advanced Weapon Dealer
item.overview: The Advanced Weapon Dealer wears a black coat with a striped red dress shirt underneath, blue jeans with brown knee pads, and grey shoes. He also has golden brown gloves and utility belt, a black bandanna tied around his neck, a golden shoulder guard with a strap across his chest, and orange hair.

item.name: Adventurer
item.overview: The Adventurer wears brown clothes with skin-colored pants and skin-colored headbands with a white hat with orange lines, he uses the Heeeeeey face.

item.name: Agony
item.overview: Agony spawned every 20 minutes during the event, this spawn alternating between Agony and Ashen within the Grand Colosseum. He despawned after 9 minutes. When he spawned, the following system message "Pain takes form at the Colosseum." appeared. Agony revived as a Tormented Boss after he had low health, increasing his HP from 55,000 to 200,000. After he was defeated or time had passed, the message "Pain recedes." appeared.

item.name: Alchemist
item.overview: The Alchemist is located at the Green Zone, near the Marine Quest Giver. He can be easily found by following the path that leads to Orbitus and going to the left when a rock close to the quest giver is seen. The Alchemist will be underneath a blue mushroom and some leaves.

item.name: Ancient Beast
item.overview: The Ancient Beast is located on the 5th floor of a dungeon, typically being the first boss the player faces on any difficulty. He has 2 phases, similar to rip_indra True Form.

item.name: Ancient Monk
item.overview: The Ancient Monk is an NPC that teaches the Godhuman Fighting Style.

item.name: Ancient One
item.overview: The Ancient One is located at the Temple of Time, which can be accessed by speaking to the Mysterious Force NPC on top of Great Tree. After pulling the lever, the player can access the Trial Rooms. The Ancient One can be found near the bookshelf and right near the stairs leading to the Ancient Clock.

item.name: Ancient Vampire
item.overview: The Ancient Vampires usually come in waves, along with Ancient Zombies. They utilize Combat melee attacks, Flash Step and Aura, which means Elemental Reflex doesn't work on them.

item.name: Ancient Zombie
item.overview: The Ancient Zombies are Lv. 2000 enemies that are a part of the Trial of Carnage. They must be defeated in order to pass the Ghoul V4 race trial.

item.name: Angler (NPC)
item.overview: Players must reach at least Fishing level 20 to interact with the Angler. Upon interaction, the Angler provides three dialogue options, with some requiring specific conditions to unlock.

item.name: Arctic Warrior
item.overview: The Arctic Warriors wear an open, black parka with white fur linings and a hood, a pair of black and blue pants and a similarly colored shirt with a net-like pattern over them, and cyan boots. They also have black, scraggly hair, goggles, and a ski mask.

item.name: Area 1 Quest Giver
item.overview: The Area 1 Quest Giver can be found upon following the brown path between the Raiders and going up the slope, to the left.

item.name: Area 2 Quest Giver
item.overview: The Area 2 Quest Giver can be found near the Swan Pirates.

item.name: Arena Trainer
item.overview: The Arena Trainer is under the Hydra statue on the opposite side of where the Hydra Leader boss is located.

item.name: Arlthmetic
item.overview: arlthmetic is located at the Hot and Cold island, under the castle where Smoke Admiral spawns. The player should go to the back of the castle and see a big wooden door that is ajar and the play should walk in and find arlthmetic.

item.name: Arowe
item.overview: Upgrading a race will result in a race skill being unlocked, which is activated with the T key, and if the players Race is not Human, a cosmetic will be added to their avatar depending on the players current race (Only applies in game).

item.name: Ashen
item.overview: Ashen spawned every 20 minutes during the Celebration Event, this spawn alternating between Agony and Ashen within the Grand Colosseum. He would despawn after 9 minutes. Ashen appeared with a group of Lightning Bandits when he spawned.

item.name: Aura Editor
item.overview: The Aura Editor is present in specific locations of every sea.
item.location: Middle TownKingdom of RoseCastle on the Sea

item.name: Awakened Ice Admiral
item.overview: The Awakened Ice Admiral wears a pair of light blue pants and vest, a very dark red (almost brown) dress shirt, a green bowtie and the Marine version of the Coat on his back. He also has bushy eyebrows, stubble on his chin and upper lip, and slicked brown hair.

item.name: Awakenings Expert
item.overview: The Awakenings Expert is an NPC that lets the player revert the awakened moves of their fruit back to the unawakened moves.

item.name: Baking Staff
item.overview: The Baking Staff wear a yellow shirt with buttons on each side of their abdomen area, along with a gold hood that covers the top of their head. They also wear blue-grey jeans.

item.name: Bandit
item.overview: The Bandits sport disheveled brown hair and, similar to the Trainees, have the Serious Scar Face. They wear a brown vest, paired with grey pants, and have slightly X-shaped bandages wrapped around their fists. Additionally, they wear black undershirts and shoes.

item.name: Bandit Quest Giver
item.overview: The Bandit Quest Giver wears a pirate hat with a red line and a skull with a semi-open red shirt and a red ribbon in his right hand with black pants and red shoes with black ropes, he wears the Heeeeeey face.

item.name: Barista
item.overview: The Barista allows the player to craft Aura, Dragon, and Eagle skins via drinkable concoctions of materials varying by recipe: Berries, Fire Feathers, and as materials; or alternatively purchasing them with . The recipes used for crafting Aura skins can be obtained from the Barista Cousin.

item.name: Barista Cousin
item.overview: The Barista Cousin spawns at a set location 20 minutes after a server starts, despawns after 20 minutes of being spawned, and respawns two minutes after despawning, which restarts the timer. This process will be repeated infinitely until a server is shut down.

item.name: Bartilo
item.overview: This quest is needed to be completed in order to talk to the Alchemist and upgrade the player's Race to V2.

item.name: Beast Hunter (NPC)
item.overview: The Beast Hunter can be found at the Tiki Outpost, to the right of the Boat Dealers, in the green-mossy building's top floor.

item.name: Beautiful Pirate
item.overview: The Beautiful Pirate has two appearances:

item.name: Blacksmith
item.overview: Players must upgrade their weapons through the Blacksmith before being able to enchant them.

item.name: Bladesmith
item.overview: The Bladesmiths have blonde, short hair, a black bandana covering their mouth, a dark shirt without sleeves, and two silver arm wears.

item.name: Blox Fruit Dealer
item.overview: The Blox Fruit Dealer wears a black chainmail shirt with a brown belt, and a red shirt and pants underneath it. He has brown, short hair, and wears black, cross-strapped sandals, and a black tricorn with a red lining. His skin is moderately tanned.
item.location: Pirate StarterMarine StarterMiddle TownKingdom of RoseCaféPort TownMansion

item.name: Blox Fruit Gacha
item.overview: Every two hours, the player is able to purchase a random physical Blox Fruit at the cost of Money depending on their level. It has a significantly smaller chance of getting a good fruit compared to the spawn chance.

item.name: Blox Fruits Dealer Cousin
item.overview: The Blox Fruits Dealer Cousin would give players a random physical Blox Fruit if they paid Money . The player could end up getting any fruit in the game; each fruit had a different chance of obtaining from him, the rare ones usually being more difficult to obtain.

item.name: Bobby
item.overview: Bobby had a clown nose with blue hair, a cross-bone tattoo across his face with two scars cutting through each eye, an orange pirate hat with black shoes, some white pants with a blue belt and a green and white striped shirt with red gloves. He also wore a red scarf around his neck bearing a green gem bordered with yellow casing.

item.name: Bone Wraith
item.overview: The Bone Wraiths could appear after opening a Cursed Chest.

item.name: Bounty/Honor Expert
item.overview: The Bounty/Honor Expert can be found in the Second Sea, in the Café next to tort, as well as on Floating Turtle in the Third Sea, next to the Awakenings Expert.

item.name: Brute
item.overview: The Brutes wear a brown shirt with a black vest and also wear blue pants and gray shoes. Additionally, they have black hair and a "Hmmm" face.

item.name: Butler
item.overview: Like the Customer of the Second Sea, this NPC gives information about the Third Sea and the items in it, usually through vague references, cryptic messages, numerous hints related to puzzles, and occasional events.

item.name: Cake Guard
item.overview: The Cake Guards are found in the Cake Island sub-area of the Sea of Treats, located in the Third Sea. They can also be found in Dungeons.

item.name: Cake Prince
item.overview: The Cake Prince is summoned if the player interacts with drip_mama after 500 enemies have been defeated at the Cake Land.

item.name: Cake Queen
item.overview: Server hopping for the Cake Queen is a good way to farm mastery, money and Bounty/Honor. Her health and damage output is very high, so if possible, the player should get a good powerful fruit (such as Buddha), sword, and/or other people to assist them.

item.name: Cake Quest Giver 1
item.overview: The Cake Quest Giver 1 can be found in the Cake Land of Sea of Treats, between the Cookie Crafters and Cake Guards.

item.name: Cake Quest Giver 2
item.overview: The Cake Quest Giver 2 can be found in the Cake Land of Sea of Treats, under a tree near the Baking Staff.

item.name: Cake Scientist
item.overview: To access the Cake Scientist's room, the player needs to get a Red Key, which is a guaranteed drop of Dough King. After obtaining the key, the player must walk to the door to the Cake Scientist's room with the key equipped.

item.name: Candy Cane Quest Giver
item.overview: The Candy Cane Quest Giver can be found in the North Pole of Sea of Treats.

item.name: Candy Pirate
item.overview: The Candy Pirates wear a brown coat with a red sweater underneath, black pants with a black belt and silver buckle, and black boots with white fur around the tops. They also have brown, spiky hair, a red and white striped scarf, and Aura on their fists.

item.name: Candy Rebel
item.overview: The Candy Rebels are found in Chocolate Land, Sea of Treats, in the Third Sea.

item.name: Captain Elephant
item.overview: Captain Elephant wears a damaged brown shirt with purple pants and brown shoes with yellow hair and the Jaw Shield in his mouth. He also has grey skin and uses Aura.

item.name: Celebration Teleporter
item.overview: The Celebration Teleporter was an event-related NPC.

item.name: Celestial Fisherman
item.overview: The Celestial Fisherman can be found in the Celestial Domain, on the left side of the Spirit Tree area.

item.name: Celestial Gacha
item.overview: The Celestial Gacha is located on one of the islands within the Celestial Domain.

item.name: Celestial Member
item.overview: During the RIP Event, the Celestial Member allows players to teleport into the Celestial Domain.

item.name: Celestial Soldier
item.overview: The Celestial Soldiers spawn every five minutes in the Celestial Domain. Whenever they spawn, a system message will appear, saying: "Celestial Soldiers are patrolling nearby." A total of 16* Celestial Soldiers can exist. (Two islands on the ground level, two islands in the sky near the center tower.)

item.name: Chef
item.overview: The Chef is located in the Pirate Village, outside the yellow house in front of the Brutes.

item.name: Chief Petty Officer
item.overview: The Chief Petty Officers have black hair and wear the Serious Scar Face with the Marine uniform.

item.name: Chief Warden
item.overview: The Chief Warden wears a pair of emerald-green cargo shorts with silver, diamond shaped studs, and brown shoes. He has an Egyptian headdress, with black bat-like wings growing from his back. He does not wear a shirt, and his chest is consequently visible.

item.name: Chocolate Bar Battler
item.overview: The Chocolate Bar Battlers are found at Chocolate Land in Sea of Treats, Third Sea.

item.name: Chocolate Quest Giver 1
item.overview: The Chocolate Quest Giver 1 can be found in the Chocolate Land of Sea of Treats, in front of a rock between the Cocoa Warriors and Chocolate Bar Battlers.

item.name: Chocolate Quest Giver 2
item.overview: The Chocolate Quest Giver 2 can be found in the Chocolate Land of Sea of Treats.

item.name: Citizen
item.overview: The Citizen can be found near the Mansion, Third Sea.

item.name: Cocoa Warrior
item.overview: The Cocoa Warriors are located at the Chocolate Land.

item.name: Colors Specialist
item.overview: If a player interacted with the Colors Specialist, they could equip all of the colors that the player had purchased from the Master of Auras, by the Horned Man quest, by the event shop or bought with Robux . The player could also disable the color, returning it to the original black Aura.

item.name: Colosseum Quest Giver
item.overview: The Colosseum Quest Giver is located at the path between the Toga Warriors and the Gladiators, near a pillar.

item.name: Cookie Crafter
item.overview: The Cookie Crafters have spiky pink hair and wear a green shirt with yellow circles, along with brown pants and pink shoes.

item.name: Coral Pirate
item.overview: The Coral Pirates are located at the Submerged Island to the right of spawn at some buildings.

item.name: Core
item.overview: The Core spawns in 1 hour and 30 minutes. When the Factory Raid starts, players have five minutes to destroy the core. Otherwise, the door will close, and a poison will spread, killing all players who are still in the factory.

item.name: Cousin Remastered
item.overview: The Cousin Remastered was placed in Middle Town.

item.name: Crew Captain
item.overview: If the player does not own a crew or does not have enough fragments to purchase a crew slot, the Crew Captain will say "What's up?"

item.name: Crypt Master
item.overview: The Crypt Master is located by the tall stone building behind the Mansion on the Floating Turtle, he will open the door to the Crypt.

item.name: Cupid Valentine Quest Giver
item.overview: The Cupid Valentine Quest Giver was a Quest NPC.

item.name: Cursed Captain
item.overview: The Cursed Captain spawns every 3 nights (guaranteed in the first full moon of a server), in the middle of a big room located at the second floor of Cursed Ship, Second Sea.
item.spawnTime: Every 3 Nights (Guaranteed In The First Full Moon Of A Server)

item.name: Cursed Skeleton
item.overview: The Cursed Skeletons can spawn in both the Heaven Dimension and the Hell Dimension.

item.name: Cursed Skeleton Boss
item.overview: The Cursed Skeleton Boss is located at the Crypt, at Floating Turtle, in Third Sea.

item.name: Customer
item.overview: The Customer can be found standing close at the counter near the Manager in The Café, which is located in the Second Sea.

item.name: Cyborg (Boss)
item.overview: The Cyborg has a robotic left arm with a blue vest, yellow shirt, and black pants with snow white spiky hair. Cyborg is also wearing blue goggles and iron nails on his face. He uses Rocket as his main attacking method.

item.name: Cyborg (NPC)
item.overview: If the player does not have enough fragments, the Cyborg will say:

item.name: Dangerous Prisoner
item.overview: The Dangerous Prisoners wear a red shirt with black lines and black shoes and black hair, they wear the Serious Scar Face.

item.name: Dark Master
item.overview: The Dark Masters wear white and blue pants with brown and black shoes and also wear white and brown clothes with purple hands and black wings on their back with a balaclava.

item.name: Dark Step Teacher
item.overview: The Dark Step Teacher teaches the player Dark Step for 150,000.
item.location: Pirate VillageHot and ColdCastle on the Sea

item.name: Darkbeard
item.overview: "The power of darkness has been unleashed."

item.name: Deandre
item.overview: Deandre can spawn in various places in the Third Sea, all spawn locations can be found here.

item.name: Death King
item.overview: The Death King is located in a mausoleum in the graveyard of the Haunted Castle, Third Sea.

item.name: Deep Forest Area 2 Quest Giver
item.overview: The Deep Forest Area 2 Quest Giver can be found near in between the Musketeer Pirate's camp and the valley of the Pineapple Houses.

item.name: Deep Forest Quest Giver
item.overview: The Deep Forest Quest Giver can be found near the Mansion (Third Sea), close to the Forest Pirates.

item.name: Demonic Soul
item.overview: The Demonic Souls can be found inside the Haunted Castle, Third Sea.

item.name: Desert Adventurer
item.overview: The Desert Adventurer is located at the Desert, First Sea.

item.name: Desert Bandit
item.overview: The Desert Bandits wear a white and grey vest and shirt, in addition, they wear black pants and a balaclava with glasses that completely covers their face.

item.name: Desert Officer
item.overview: The Desert Officers have black hair with dark green parts at the ends, they also wear a brown shirt and pants at the end and they use the "Raig Face".

item.name: Diablo
item.overview: Diablo can spawn in various places in the Third Sea, all spawn locations can be found here.

item.name: Diamond (Boss)
item.overview: Diamond is a tall, medium-sized man with a variety of leaves forming a shape behind his head. He also wears a green shirt which exposes his chest, along with brown pants with some visuals in it.

item.name: Dog House (Indra)
item.overview: In the First Sea, if the player does the right dialogue, A part of The Son Quest will be completed, Giving them a quest to find love letters. The love letters are scattered across the map in the Frozen Village, Marine Fortress, and Skylands.

item.name: Dog House (Wenlock)
item.overview: The Wenlock Dog House is located to the left of the Arowe NPC, inside a secret room located under the Diamond boss.

item.name: Dojo Trainer
item.overview: The Dojo Trainer is located inside the Dragon Dojo, in Hydra Island.

item.name: Don Swan
item.overview: Don Swan wears a black robe with maroon stripes, which is short enough to reveal muscles on his arms and torso, and maroon shoes. On his back, he wears the Pink Coat, and has black, spiky hair, a large, toothy grin, as well as a pair of Swan Glasses.

item.name: Dough King
item.overview: "A dimension worthy of a god has spawned."

item.name: Dragon Crew Archer
item.overview: The Dragon Crew Archers wear a white and yellow shirt with red, black and white pants with bandages on their hands and an orange bandanna covering their mouth with orange hair. They use the Serious Scar Face.

item.name: Dragon Crew Quest Giver
item.overview: The Dragon Crew Quest Giver can be found near the Friendly Arena, close to the Dragon Crew Warriors.

item.name: Dragon Crew Warrior
item.overview: The Dragon Crew Warriors wear orange and black shirts with brown and yellow bandages with red, white, yellow, and black pants with sandals and red hair with horns, they use the Classic Vampire face.

item.name: Dragon Hunter
item.overview: The Dragon Hunter is located at the Dragon Dojo in Hydra Island, Third Sea.

item.name: Dragon Talon Sage
item.overview: The Dragon Talon Sage is an NPC who allows players to craft Scrolls and apply Enchantments to weapons.
item.location: JungleMiddle TownSnow MountainKingdom of RoseCaféTiki Outpost

item.name: Dragon Tamer
item.overview: The Dragon Tamer can be found in two seas:

item.name: Dragon Wizard
item.overview: The Dragon Wizard wears a red cape, black shirt and pants, seems to have a brown and red-stripped wizard hat, a long, white beard, and a calm expression.

item.name: Drip mama
item.overview: drip_mama allows the player to see how many more enemies they need to defeat to summon Cake Prince or Dough King raid. (Note: It will only count the amount of killed NPCs on the Cake Land.)

item.name: El Admin
item.overview: El Admin can be found in the middle room of the left-side sleeping quarters of the Cursed Ship. The player must be at least Lv. 1000 to enter the Cursed Ship through the door.

item.name: El Perro
item.overview: El Perro is located next to the Ship Deckhands on the right side of the Cursed Ship exit, beside a bed.

item.name: El Rodolfo
item.overview: El Rodolfo is found at the bottom floor of the Cursed Ship near the Ship Engineers. The player must be at least Lv. 1000 to enter the Cursed Ship.

item.name: Elite Hunter
item.overview: Elite Hunter is a quest NPC that gives players quests to defeat one of the three Elite Pirates and Tyrant of the Skies.

item.name: Elite Pirates
item.overview: Currently, there are three Elite Pirates in the game: Deandre, Diablo and Urban. However if Tyrant of the Skies is spawned, he can be defeated as an Elite Pirate.
item.purpose: Obtaining God's Chalice, Dojo Belt (Purple), and Yama

item.name: Erin
item.overview: Erin is an NPC whose only purpose is to show the player the fighting scene between rip_indra and mygame43.

item.name: Event Shop
item.overview: The Event Shop is a special NPC shop that appears during limited-time events. Players can exchange event-specific materials for items from a rotating stock.

item.name: Evil Wraith
item.overview: The Evil Wraiths could be spawned by opening a Cursed Chest.

item.name: Experienced Captain
item.overview: The Experienced Captain is located at the Middle Town and on the docks of the Port Town.

item.name: Experimic
item.overview: Experimic will change the player's race to Ghoul after paying 100 Ectoplasms and a Hellfire Torch. This purchase is permanent, meaning the player will not lose access to Ghoul upon switching to another Race.

item.name: Factory Staff
item.overview: The Factory Staff wear a scientist suit with safety goggles that cover their eyes and have black hair.

item.name: Fajita
item.overview: Fajita had brown, bushy hair, eyebrows and a beard, and a straight scar across the top of his nose. He wore the marine version of the Coat with golden decoration and a black collar, a green robe with a maroon edge, and brown pants. He also held the Gravity Blade.

item.name: Felku
item.overview: Currently only being seen in trailers and bulletins, 'Felku' seems to be an 'enemy' of Shafi, being partnered up with Suizei. He is the leader of a 'BAMP' lair. He claims to be the King of Fruits.

item.name: Female Islander
item.overview: The Female Islanders wore a red, yellow and black shirt with black pants and black shoes with a white, yellow and black necklace on their neck and red hair. They use the Winky face which is similar to Kilo Admiral's.

item.name: Fire Quest Giver
item.overview: The Fire Quest Giver can be found on the Hot side of Hot and Cold, near the stone path leading to the Smoke Admiral.

item.name: Fish Crew Member
item.overview: The Fish Crew Members have Shark V3 visuals. They can have different skin colors: blue, green, pink, or red. They can also have different hair styles.

item.name: Fisherman
item.overview: Players can get a Fishing Rod and 10 Basic Baits by interacting with the Fisherman for the first time. Afterwards, the player is able to check their Job Stats, Fishing Index, sell Fishes and buy 10 Basic Baits for 1,000 (Basic Bait stacking caps at 99).

item.name: Fishman Captain
item.overview: The Fishman Captains wear an open green shirt with damaged blue pants and two red bandages, one on their pants and another on one chest with black and brown sandals with green spiked hair. They use the Mildly Irritated Face.

item.name: Fishman Commando
item.overview: The Fishman Commandos can be found at the right side of the Underwater City.

item.name: Fishman Lord
item.overview: The Fishman Lord has two appearances which are:

item.name: Fishman Raider
item.overview: The Fishman Raiders wear an open black shirt with a green collar and sleeve bands, blue shorts, and a red necktie. They also wear yellow knee-covers and black sandals. They have jet-black, messy hair, mint-green skin, and muscles on their chests and arms.

item.name: Fishman Warrior
item.overview: The Fishman Warriors wear a blue shirt and pants with green lines on their clothes and a red ribbon on their chest, they have pink skin with blue hair and use the face Heeeeeey.

item.name: Forest Pirate
item.overview: The Forest Pirates wear a white shirt with white and red pants with orange shoes and red spiky hair. They use the The Big Dog Face.

item.name: Forgotten Quest Giver
item.overview: The Forgotten Quest Giver can be found behind the skull of Forgotten Island, near the Water Fighters.

item.name: Fossil Expert
item.overview: The Fossil Expert can be found in the Prehistoric Island, Third Sea.

item.name: Freezeburg Quest Giver
item.overview: The Freezeburg Quest Giver can be found to the left of the main entrance of Fountain City, near the Galley Pirates.

item.name: Front Crew Quest Giver
item.overview: The Front Crew Quest Giver can be found near the stairs leading to the second floor of the Cursed Ship, in front of the entrance to the Ship Stewards.

item.name: Frost Quest Giver
item.overview: The Frost Quest Giver can be found to the left of the Ice Castle, near the Snow Lurkers.

item.name: Frozen Watcher
item.overview: The Frozen Watcher is an NPC that is required for the player to interact with in order to spawn the Leviathan.

item.name: Galley Captain
item.overview: The Galley Captains wear black and white clothes and pants, their face is the "Raig Face" and they wear the "Rising Sun Samurai" hat.

item.name: Galley Pirate
item.overview: The Galley Pirates wear grey and black clothing, a grey helmet with four spikes and a red dot in the center, they use the Raig Face.

item.name: Gas Knight
item.overview: The Gas Knight is located on the 15th floor of a dungeon. He is the final boss on Easy Mode, not in Hard and Challenge mode (Due to Zero being the last).

item.name: Ghost (Enemy)
item.overview: Ghosts wear a torn brown shirt with torn black pants with white fur. They use the Zombie Face.

item.name: Ghost (NPC)
item.overview: The Ghost NPC is located at the Haunted Castle, Third Sea.

item.name: Giant Islander
item.overview: The Giant Islanders wore a red, skin and black headband with white lines with black pants with the same headband and orange hair. They had the Miss Scarlet Face.

item.name: Gladiator
item.overview: The Gladiators wear yellow and white shirts and pants and also wear an iron helmet that covers their entire face except their eyes.
item.immunityLevel: 277 (doesn't works on Level 278) but works again after Level 279

item.name: God's Guard
item.overview: God's Guards wear a purple shirt with blue pants and a yellow headband with black shoes and a white artist hat with their Angel Wings on their back, they use the Mildly Irritated Face.

item.name: Gorilla
item.overview: The Gorillas have unkempt black hair and a grey-pink face. They have a hairy body, a six-pack, and dark hairs around their fists.

item.name: Gorilla God
item.overview: The Gorilla God can be found in the Dungeons, in one of the random floors on Hard Mode leading up to Zero.

item.name: Grand Devotee
item.overview: The Grand Devotees are located at the Submerged Island near the High Disciples in a temple like building.

item.name: Gravestone
item.overview: The Gravestone is located at the Haunted Castle.

item.name: Graveyard Quest Giver
item.overview: The Graveyard Quest Giver can be found at the main island of Graveyard Island, among the Zombies.

item.name: Greedy Elf
item.overview: The Greedy Elf can be found near center of North Pole in First Sea and Second Sea or Candy Cane Land in Sea of Treats in Third Sea.

item.name: Greybeard
item.overview: "Loud tremors are being heard across the seas..."

item.name: Guashiem
item.overview: Guashiem is very easy to find as he is the only NPC in the Cursed Ship that looks like a dog/white kitsune.

item.name: Halloween Gacha Dealer
item.overview: The Halloween Gacha Dealer was an event NPC.

item.name: Hasan
item.overview: Hasan is located in the secret tunnel under the silver chest near the pyramid on the Desert. The player must walk through the passage, then jump at the end to enter the pyramid and meet Hasan.

item.name: Haunted Castle Quest Giver 1
item.overview: The Haunted Castle Quest Giver 1 can be found inside the grey hut, in the center of the Haunted Castle.

item.name: Haunted Castle Quest Giver 2
item.overview: The Haunted Castle Quest Giver 2 can be found near the front door of the Haunted Castle, near the Demonic Souls.

item.name: Haunted Crew Member
item.overview: The Haunted Crew Members also leave a bluish-green glow similar to Ghost's Resurrection Passive.

item.name: Head Baker
item.overview: The Head Bakers wear an open, golden jacket that shows their muscles, and blue jeans with gold and purple shoes. They wear a golden helmet with a face guard and a green necktie. Their fists are also black due to them being imbued with Aura.

item.name: Head Jailer
item.overview: The Head Jailer is located at the front of Swan's spawn castle, to the left in the Prison .

item.name: Heaven's Guardian
item.overview: The Heaven's Guardian appears after lighting up the third torch in the Soulless scroll quest. He uses the awakened old version of the Light fruit and he possesses the Angel race but doesn't have any abilities or buffs from it. Most of his attacks cannot be dodged because of the fast start-up of the moves. He also utilizes Aura.

item.name: Hell's Messenger
item.overview: The Hell's Messenger appears after lighting up the third torch in the Fear the Reaper scroll quest. He uses the awakened version of the Dark fruit and also utilizes Aura. He is easier to beat than Heaven's Guardian mostly due to the attacks being easy to dodge.

item.name: High Disciple
item.overview: The High Disciples are located at the Submerged Island to the right of spawn near the back of the island.

item.name: Horned Man
item.overview: To begin the quest, talk to the Horned Man. He will then tell the player to defeat these Bosses in order:

item.name: Horned Warrior
item.overview: The Horned Warriors wear blue clothing with a blue hat and ice blue horns with a mask that covers their mouth.

item.name: Hungry Man
item.overview: The Hungry Man wears a brown, raggedy pair of pants and shirt, which have had their sleeves torn off, and are riddled with various holes. He wears no shoes, and is also bald, and has no hat to cover his head.

item.name: Hydra Enforcer
item.overview: The Hydra Enforcers are Lv. 1625 enemies.

item.name: Hydra Leader
item.overview: The Hydra Leader wears a black and purple outfit and a purple band around her waist. She has a black mask covering the majority of her face and wear a black conical hat on her head. Her outfit is similar to the Venomous Assailants'.

item.name: Hydra Town Quest Giver
item.overview: The Hydra Town Quest Giver can be found near the lake of Hydra Town, close to the Dragon Dojo.

item.name: Ice Admiral
item.overview: The Ice Admiral wears a white suit vest, and white pants, along with a red dress shirt underneath. He also has a green bowtie, black shoes, combed hair, and bushy eyebrows. He wears the marine version of the Coat, which hangs off his back, and has visible muscles on his legs and arms.

item.name: Ice Cream Chef
item.overview: The Ice Cream Chefs are located at the Sea of Treats.

item.name: Ice Cream Commander
item.overview: Ice Cream Commanders are located at Sea of Treats, Ice Cream Land, Third Sea.

item.name: Ice Cream Quest Giver
item.overview: The Ice Cream Quest Giver can be found in the Ice Cream Land of Sea of Treats, near the Ice Cream Chefs.

item.name: Ice Quest Giver
item.overview: The Ice Quest Giver can be found at the left side of the door leading to the gray tower at the Cold side of Hot and Cold, near the Lab Subordinates.

item.name: Indra Egg
item.overview: To access this boss, the player must collect the first 23 Eggs in the Easter Egg Hunt Codex. The player can then interact with the Easter Shop NPC and select the "Secret" dialogue option to get a free Easter Chalice at the first time or trade 2,000 Candy Eggs for it in the 2nd or above time.

item.name: Instinct Teacher
item.overview: The Instinct Teacher is located at the Aztec-like Temple structure within the second area of the Upper Skylands, to the left of the Thunder God Boss.

item.name: Island Boy
item.overview: The Island Boys have long brown hair, with their muscles exposed and tattoos on both of their arms. In addition to this, they wear a necklace, a pair of gloves, along with short blue jeans and brown shoes.

item.name: Island Empress
item.overview: The Island Empress spawned every 25 minutes. She was located in front of the palace at the Hydra Island in the Third Sea.

item.name: Isle Champion
item.overview: The Isle Champions are located at the Tiki Outpost.

item.name: Isle Outlaw
item.overview: The Isle Outlaws are located in Tiki Outpost near the Tiki Quest Giver 1.

item.name: Jail Keeper
item.overview: The Jail Keeper is located to the left of where Swan spawns.

item.name: Jeremy
item.overview: Jeremy wears a pink T-shirt with white pants with black shoes and a black ribbon on his pants with yellow hair and sunglasses that cover his eyes.

item.name: Jungle Pirate
item.overview: The Jungle Pirates wear a green and yellow shirt with a green bowtie and yellow shoes with yellow fur and bunny ears on their head. They use the Demented Mouse Face.

item.name: Kilo Admiral
item.overview: The Kilo Admiral wears green clothes with watermelon images, green bracelets, dark green shoes, a green helmet covering brown hair, a green umbrella on her head, and the Lei on her neck. She uses the Winky face.

item.name: King Neptune
item.overview: King Neptune is located in front of the corals to the right of the Fishman Warriors.

item.name: King Red Head
item.overview: King Red Head can be found in the prisoners cell along with the Gladiators, under the Colosseum (Second Sea).

item.name: Kitsune Lord
item.overview: The Kitsune Lord is location on the 10th floor of a dungeon. He is the second boss the player faces at any difficulty.

item.name: Lab Subordinate
item.overview: The Lab Subordinates wear a brown coat, a white shirt, blue pants with blue hair, they use the Mildly Irritated Face.

item.name: Lava Golem
item.overview: The Lava Golems are large, rocky, humanoid creatures made out of magma and rocks with yellow glowing eyes. They are tall with sharp, yellow claws, and have a pair of orange horns on their head, along with a hole on their waist and yellow-tipped spikes covering their entire body. Their burly physique suggests the word "Golem" in their name.

item.name: Lava Pirate
item.overview: The Lava Pirates wear red clothes with a grey ribbon and brown gloves with red and black wings and red hair, they use the Don't Wake Me Up face

item.name: Layandikit12
item.overview: Layandikit12 could be found inside a cake castle in the Cake Land, in a room with large bookshelves, near the dough raid door. It could be seen standing next to a red couch.

item.name: Legendary Sword Dealer
item.overview: The Legendary Sword Dealer wears a formal, all-black outfit consisting of a sleek suit jacket with matching trousers, paired with a crisp white shirt and a black tie. Completing the look is a classic black fedora, giving the character a sharp, mysterious, and elegant appearance.
item.location: Kingdom of RoseGreen ZoneGraveyard IslandRemote Island

item.name: Leviathan
item.overview: The Leviathan can be summoned by the Frozen Watcher.

item.name: Lightning Bandit
item.overview: The Lightning Bandits wear two cyan circles on the head, alongside a blue jacket and a light blue short.

item.name: Living Skeleton
item.overview: The Living Skeleton will sell the player the Soul Cane for 750,000.

item.name: Living Zombie
item.overview: The Living Zombies wear damaged white shirts with green and purple skin and brown hair. They use the Zombie Face.

item.name: Longma
item.overview: Longma is located at the Floating Turtle, behind a door near the Previous Hero. This boss is only accessible after completing the Tushita Puzzle in the Third Sea.

item.name: Lucien
item.overview: Lucien is located at Hot and Cold Island in the Second Sea, Castle on the Sea in the Third Sea and the Simulation Hub.
item.location: Hot and ColdCastle on the SeaSimulation Hub

item.name: Luckymaxer (Boss)
item.overview: Luckymaxer has medium-length brown hair, a white bunny-eared hat with a small burst effect, a blue sleeveless shirt, and light green pants as well as yellow arms. He also wields the Ban Hammer.

item.name: Luckymaxer (NPC)
item.overview: After defeating the Luckymaxer raid boss, the player can interact with this NPC and roll for a Plastic Fruit for free.

item.name: Lunoven
item.overview: Lunoven is located in the bar in front of the raid room at Castle on the Sea, Third Sea.

item.name: Luxury Boat Dealer
item.overview: Players can spawn luxury boats by interacting with the Luxury Boat Dealer.

item.name: Mad Scientist
item.overview: The Mad Scientist sells the Electric Fighting Style at the cost of 500,000.
item.location: SkylandsHot and ColdCastle on the Sea

item.name: Magic Elf
item.overview: The Magic Elf can be found inside of snowman tent at the North Pole event island, close to the center.

item.name: Magma Admiral
item.overview: The Magma Admiral stands with resolve, wearing a white long coat that drapes from his torso to his lower leg (not be confused with the coat on his back). He is seen with a deep blue shirt that is similar to a marine uniform, and simple black pants. His headwear includes a pale white cap that says "MARINE", and he has a distinct white coat that hangs on his back like a cape.

item.name: Magma Ninja
item.overview: The Magma Ninjas wear brown clothing paired with black shoes, as well as yellow and brown gloves. They also have a yellow belt and two scarves—one yellow and one red with black accents. Additionally, they wear a red hat with a black ribbon that covers the lower part of their face.

item.name: Manager
item.overview: The Manager wears a forest green apron over a black dress shirt, equipped with black pants. He has dark green sneakers, combed jet black hair, and mildly tanned skin that complements the smile on his face.

item.name: Marine
item.overview: The Marine is located at the stairs leading to the Vice Admiral.

item.name: Marine Captain
item.overview: The Marine Captains have jet-black slicked up hair and a grim expression. They wear a white and blue navy coat that has some golden decorations, and a blue necktie. They also have a white shirt with golden buttons, blue pants, black shoes, and Aura covering their hands and swords.

item.name: Marine Commodore
item.overview: The Marine Commodores wear the typical Marine uniform and brown hair. They use the Raig Face.

item.name: Marine Leader
item.overview: The Marine Leader wears the costume of a sea captain with yellow hair, wears the Heeeeeey face.

item.name: Marine Lieutenant
item.overview: The Marine Lieutenants possess brown, combed hair and a unibrow. They wear a blue and white navy coat with gold decorations, and a blue necktie, plus a white button-up shirt, blue pants and black shoes.

item.name: Marine Quest Giver
item.overview: The Marine Quest Giver can be found upon going straight from the Green Zone, facing backwards behind a rock.

item.name: Marine Rear Admiral
item.overview: The Marine Rear Admirals are Lv. 1725 enemies.

item.name: Marine Recruiter
item.overview: Marine Recruiter can switch the player from the Pirates side to the Marines side when the player is a Pirate without having to quit and rejoin the game. When the player switches, their character will be reset before joining the opposite team. This means that if the player has an item (Blox Fruit or a God's Chalice) in their hotbar and switches, that item(s) will be lost.

item.name: Marine Tree Quest Giver
item.overview: The Marine Tree Quest Giver can be found in the lower level of Great Tree, in front of the Marine Commodores.

item.name: Martial Arts Master
item.overview: The Martial Arts Master is a shop NPC that can teach the Superhuman Fighting Style for 3,000,000.

item.name: Master of Auras
item.overview: The Master of Auras can sell the player Aura Colors where the colors come in 2 rarities, Regular and LEGENDARY.
item.location: Green ZoneSnow MountainHot and ColdCursed ShipIce CastleForgotten IslandPort TownCastle on the SeaHydra IslandGreat TreeFloating Turtle

item.name: Master Sword Dealer
item.overview: The Master Sword Dealer is located at the fourth island of Skylands.

item.name: Mercenary
item.overview: The Mercenaries wear blue clothing that looks like armor with a black warrior helmet covering their entire face.

item.name: Military Detective
item.overview: The Military Detective is located at the Prison.

item.name: Military Soldier
item.overview: The Military Soldiers wear a black shirt and pants with a white stripe and a black cap, they use the Serious Scar Face.

item.name: Military Spy
item.overview: The Military Spies wear a black shirt and pants with yellow stripes and also the top part of the shirt is red and they also wear a red hood and a blindfold with red eyes.

item.name: Mob Leader
item.overview: The Mob Leader wears a black and gray shirt and pants with black hair, he uses the face "Hmmm".

item.name: Mole
item.overview: The Mole can be found among the God's Guards and upon entering the Upper Skylands.

item.name: Monkey
item.overview: The Monkeys have brown skin with tan-yellow hands and rosy cheeks on their face.

item.name: Mr. Captain
item.overview: Mr. Captain is located at the docks of the Green Zone, to the right of the Bridge that connects the Kingdom of Rose to the Green Zone.

item.name: Musketeer Pirate
item.overview: The Musketeer Pirates wear a purple shirt with a blue and white swimsuit, white pants, a ribbon on their pants, black shoes, a headband with flowers, and bunny ears. They use the Demented Mouse Face. Additionally they have a ponytail with light brown hair.

item.name: Mysterious Entity
item.overview: Mysterious Entity (formerly known as Wenlocktoad Over Heaven) is an NPC that can be used to awaken the players fruit.

item.name: Mysterious Force
item.overview: When the player interacts with King Red Head, he will tell the player to go to the Great Tree. Upon reaching the top of the tree, they will encounter the Mysterious Force. Interacting with it will teleport the player to the Temple of Time.

item.name: Mysterious Man
item.overview: The Mysterious Man is a Misc. NPC who sells the True Triple Katana for 2,000,000. Though he is labelled as a "man", his appearance seems otherworldly.

item.name: Mysterious Scientist
item.overview: In the Second Sea, the NPC can be found in the laboratory in the cold zone. The player has to enter this code with the color panels: Red, Blue, Green, and Blue (1, 3, 2, 3 taps). After entering the code, a "secret door" in the form of a rectangular doorway will open, leading to a very long spiral slope. After climbing up the slope, the player should be able to see the NPC in between 8 tubes. The player must unequip anything that is currently equipped, or entering the code will not be possible.
item.location: Hot and ColdCastle on the Sea

item.name: Mythological Pirate
item.overview: The Mythological Pirates are badgers with red clothes.

item.name: Nerd
item.overview: Nerd is an NPC that will tell the player the buff(s) of the accessory that they are wearing upon being interacted with.

item.name: Norp
item.overview: norp was able to be found at a round table in the Café.

item.name: Ocean Prophet
item.overview: The Ocean Prophets are located at the Submerged Island to the left of spawn on a hill where a bridge connects to it.

item.name: Oni (NPC)
item.overview: During the Red King Event, the Oni allows players to teleport into the Oni Realm.

item.name: Oni Fisherman
item.overview: The Oni Fisherman could be found in the Oni Realm, on the right side of the dojo.

item.name: Oni Soldier
item.overview: The Oni Soldiers spawn every five minutes in the Oni Realm. Whenever they spawn, a system message will appear, saying: "A squad of Oni Guards has appeared." A total of 12 Oni Soldiers can be found at once, four on each island.

item.name: Orbitus
item.overview: Orbitus can be found at the Green Zone island in Second Sea. To find him, the player can walk straight and then to the right from the Marine Quest Giver.

item.name: Order
item.overview: Order has 256,250 HP, and uses the moves of nearly all moves of old Control and all moves of Koko. However, he cannot use the Control’s old [V] Gamma Rush.

item.name: Parlus
item.overview: Parlus wears a copper colored coat which exposes his abs. He bears a black pant and neatly combed hair with one strand sticking out in the front. He stands with his right hand behind his head.

item.name: Party Gacha
item.overview: The Party Gacha was located on the outermost floor of the Grand Colosseum during the 50B Celebration Event.

item.name: Peanut President
item.overview: The Peanut Presidents wear a brown and white shirt with a brown tie and brown pants with a brown visor with red pupils and orange hair.

item.name: Peanut Quest Giver
item.overview: The Peanut Quest Giver can be found in the Peanut Land of Sea of Treats, near the Peanut Scouts.

item.name: Peanut Scout
item.overview: The Peanut Scouts appear to be bulky, big men with muscular arms. They also wear a bandana on their face, covering their mouth.

item.name: Phoeyu, the Reformed
item.overview: Phoeyu, the Reformed is an NPC that sells the Death Step Fighting Style.

item.name: Piranha
item.overview: Piranhas are capable of leaping out of the water to attack both the player's boat and the player directly. They utilize biting and electric shocks as their primary forms of attack. When a player is hit by a Piranha, their ability to dash, jump, and use abilities is temporarily disabled. Piranhas will automatically despawn if they move too far from their original spawn point. Notably, they prioritize targeting the player over the boat and cannot be damaged using M1 attacks from fighting styles or swords.

item.name: Pirate
item.overview: The Pirates wear a pirate hat with skull on the side of it, as well as a red suit with buttons, some of which are unbuttoned, thus revealing their chest. A white leather belt is tied on their waist. They also wear black pants and red shoes.

item.name: Pirate Adventurer
item.overview: The Pirate Adventurer wears a semi-open white shirt with black pants and blue hair, he uses the Suspicious face.

item.name: Pirate Millionaire
item.overview: The Pirate Millionaires wear brown shoes with black pants and a shirt with white and red stripes with black hair and an eye patch covering their left eye. They use the Mildly Irritated Face.

item.name: Pirate Port Quest Giver
item.overview: The Pirate Port Quest Giver can be found on the lower level of Port Town, close to the wooden docks and the Pirate Millionaires.

item.name: Pirate Recruiter
item.overview: The Pirate Recruiter can switch the player from the Marine side to the Pirate side when the player is a Marine without having to quit and rejoin the game. When the player switches, their character will be reset before joining the opposite team. This means that if the player has an item (Blox Fruit or a God's Chalice) in their hotbar and switches, that item(s) will be lost.

item.name: Pistol Billionaire
item.overview: The Pistol Billionaires wear a semi-open yellow shirt with ribbons on their muscles and a belt under their shirt and they wear blue pants with brown shoes and brown hair, they use the Raig Face.

item.name: Player Hunter
item.overview: Similar to the Wanted Poster, the Player Hunter can give players a quest for killing a random player on the server, and the player can only receive quests for players who have their PvP on. When the player receives the quest, the Player Hunter will provide the random player's location. If the player has a quest, and another player kills the player that the player is assigned on the quest, their quest will be cancelled. After the player finishes the quest, a cooldown of 10 minutes will be set up for their next one.

item.name: Plokster
item.overview: Plokster can be found on the bridge between Kingdom of Rose and Green Zone, as well as inside the building with a blue roof at the Castle on the Sea.
item.location: Kingdom of RoseCastle on the Sea

item.name: Posessed Mummy
item.overview: The Posessed Mummies wear a black shirt with yellow ribbons all over various parts of their body with blue pants with their legs sewn together and a ribbon across their face with one eye and an Egyptian hat with a snake.

item.name: Previous Hero
item.overview: The Previous Hero is a Misc NPC that sells the Electric Claw fighting style.

item.name: Prisoner
item.overview: The Prisoners wear a black and white prisoner outfit with a Pal Hair and have a scar on their left cheek.

item.name: Raid Bosses
item.overview: Raid Bosses are enemies that are normally stronger than normal bosses.

item.name: Raider
item.overview: The Raiders wear red and black clothes with a red ribbon on their chest and brown hair with the face Dont Wake Me Up.

item.name: Rear Crew Quest Giver
item.overview: The Rear Crew Quest Giver can be found to the left upon entering the Cursed Ship, near the entrance to the Ship Deckhands.

item.name: Reborn Skeleton
item.overview: The Reborn Skeletons are located at the graveyard to the left of the Haunted Castle, in the Third Sea.

item.name: Red Army Recruiter
item.overview: The Red Army Recruiter was located on near the outer wall of the Grand Colosseum. He stood at the beginning of the road leading to the Oni Realm

item.name: Red Commander
item.overview: The Red Commander spawned every hour at XX:30 (12:30, 1:30, 2:30, etc.) in the Oni Realm (Interior) and despawns after 15 minutes. The following system messages will appear when he spawns: "The entrance to the Oni Realm is opening...", followed by "The Red Commander beckons from his throne." at which the boss spawns. After 15 minutes have passed, the following system message appeared when the Red Commander despawns: "Your strength fails to impress the Red Commander—he vanishes."

item.name: Red Gacha
item.overview: The Red Gacha can be found in the Oni Realm.

item.name: Red Infantry
item.overview: The Red Infantry arrive in waves in the Celestial Domain during a Raid upon the Spirit tree.

item.name: Red Legionnaire
item.overview: The Red Legionnaires arrive during a raid upon the Spirit Tree of the Celestial Domain.

item.name: Reef Bandit
item.overview: The Reef Bandits are located at the Submerged Island in a reef like area to the right of spawn

item.name: Remove Blox Fruit
item.overview: Remove Blox Fruit can be found at the Prison on one of the surrounding circles in the First Sea, and on the roof of the largest building at the Castle on the Sea in the Third Sea.

item.name: Rich Man
item.overview: The Rich Man wears a light blue t-shirt with clean brown pants with some white highlights. He wears black shoes and has a golden beard and hair which are connected.

item.name: Rip Commander
item.overview: The Rip Commander spawns every hour at XX:30 (12:30, 1:30, 2:30, etc.) in the Celestial Domain (Interior) and will despawn after 15 minutes have passed. The following system messages will appear when he spawns: "The Celestial Domain's lift has been activated.", followed by "RIP Commander beckons from his throne." at which the boss spawns. After 15 minutes have passed, the following system message will appear when the Rip Commander despawns: "The Rip Commander has grown tired of waiting for a proper challenge — he disappears."

item.name: Rip Family Recruiter
item.overview: The Rip Family Recruiter was located on near the outer wall of the Grand Colosseum. He stood by the beginning of the road that leads to the Celestial Domain.

item.name: Rip indra
item.overview: rip_indra takes the appearance of the admin rip_indra's old avatar.

item.name: Rip indra (NPC)
item.overview: rip_indra's only purpose is to switch the skin of the player's Dark Blade, the only options given are to switch to either the Slayer Skin or the default one.

item.name: Rip indra True Form
item.overview: rip_indra spawns inside the palace of Castle on the Sea in the Third Sea once spawned. The player can tell when Indra is spawned, as everyone’s screen shakes, and the world's atmosphere becomes covered in thick fog. The fog is very thick, so it's a bit difficult to see clearly. Similar to the Mirage Island's fog.

item.name: Rip Infantry
item.overview: The Red Infantry arrive in waves in the Oni Realm during a Raid upon the Spirit tree.

item.name: Rip Legionnaire
item.overview: The Rip Legionnaires arrive during a raid upon the Spirit Tree of the Oni Realm

item.name: Rip return
item.overview: rip_return has white legs and torso, with blue arms, and a necklace. He wears a silver pumpkin on his head with protruding horns. He also has a pair of angel wings. The model is a representation of the developer, rip_return's Roblox avatar.

item.name: Robotmega
item.overview: Robotmega can be found in the Middle Town, next to Aura Editor, in the house with the green roof.

item.name: Royal Soldier
item.overview: The Royal Soldiers wear white clothes with black shoes and a brown necklace that has a white hook and the head display is an angry goat head with a red headband with horns.

item.name: Royal Squad
item.overview: The Royal Squads wear pink clothes with Angel Wings on their back and brown hair, they use the Glory on the Gridiron face.

item.name: Saber Expert
item.overview: The Saber Expert has red hair, wears a white vest-type shirt and a black cape and has brown to black pants. He has a short beard and a small moustache and he bears a double scar beneath his left eye.

item.name: Sabi
item.overview: Sabi wears a purple scarf, light orange vest, and blue pants with black shoes. He has orange hair and he wears the Top Hat.
item.location: Kingdom of RoseCastle on the Sea

item.name: Santa Claws
item.overview: Santa Claws can be found near the Boat Dealers at the North Pole in each sea.

item.name: Sea Beast
item.overview: Sea Beasts, unlike most aggressive NPCs, are only vulnerable to special moves and are immune to most M1 attacks. There are some exceptions to these such as:
item.location: Sea Danger Level 1-6, Second Sea and Third Sea waters
item.atkPerHit: Deadly Shower: up to 2100 Water Beam: 1500 Roaring Beast: 500
item.drops: General Drops +1 Level 60,000-250,000 Choppa Top Hat 250-150 Second Sea 250 Fist of Darkness Third Sea 150 350

item.name: Sea Captain
item.overview: The Sea Captain is located on the docks of the Kingdom of Rose, Second Sea.

item.name: Sea Chanter
item.overview: The Sea Chanters are located at the Submerged Island to the left of spawn near a bridge.

item.name: Sea Soldier
item.overview: The Sea Soldiers wear a red and black t-shirt with black and red pants and red shoes with a gas mask and red and black hair.

item.name: Sealed King
item.overview: The Sealed King is the starter NPC for the Race Awakening quest. He is King Red Head and is currently believed to be sealed here by rip_indra.

item.name: Serpent Hunter
item.overview: The Serpent Hunters are located at Tiki Outpost, in the Third Sea.

item.name: Shafi
item.overview: Shafi can be found in a base linked by a tunnel near the Island Boys at Tiki Outpost, Third Sea.

item.name: Shanda
item.overview: The Shandas have brown spiky hair and small, white angel wings on their backs, with their abs and muscles exposed, and a shirt that appears to be torn. In addition to this, they wear metal elbow and shoulder guards, alongside red pants.

item.name: Shark (Enemy)
item.overview: The Sharks randomly spawn in groups of 1-5 in Second Sea and in Sea Danger Level 0-6 in Third Sea (can also spawn in First sea for easter event)

item.name: Shark Hunter
item.overview: The Shark Hunter can be found in Tiki Outpost, in the first door at the left of the central building when the player enters Tiki Outpost, Third Sea.

item.name: Sharkman Master
item.overview: The Sharkman Master is located inside the Sealed Cavern, which is near the Coral Pirates, behind a house.

item.name: Sharkman Teacher
item.overview: The Sharkman Teacher (formerly Daigrock, the Sharkman) is an NPC that teaches Sharkman Karate.

item.name: Ship Deckhand
item.overview: The Ship Deckhands wear a torn blue shirt with a brown belt and blue pants with blue shoes and brown hair, they use the Don't Wake Me Up Face.

item.name: Ship Engineer
item.overview: The Ship Engineers wear engineer t-shirts with torn and dirty black pants with a towel on their heads.

item.name: Ship Officer
item.overview: The Ship Officers wear yellow and black clothing with a brown hat and a mask that covers part of their face.

item.name: Ship Steward
item.overview: The Ship Stewards wear white clothes with black lines and black shoes with a chef's hat.

item.name: Shipwright Teacher
item.overview: The Shipwright Teacher wears a white short-sleeved shirt with a red sweater underneath, red bands on his waist and arms, a brown belt with a fancy silver buckle, and black pants with a red stripe. He also has neat, jet-black hair, toned muscles, and a black and red tricorn hat.

item.name: Shocker
item.overview: The Shockers have blonde hair and clothes that appear to be torn, exposing their chest and abs. In addition to this, electrical power flows from their fists.

item.name: Sick Man
item.overview: The Sick Man is a fairly white man wearing a brown short-sleeved ragged shirt, with bandages on his right arm and abdomen. He wears ragged beige colored pants with only a shoe on his left foot. He has a black beard and a small brown hat on his head.

item.name: Sick Scientist
item.overview: The Sick Scientist is located behind the Cookie Crafter's spawn location, at the left edge of Cake Land, Sea of Treats, Third Sea.

item.name: Skull Slayer
item.overview: The Skull Slayers are located at the Tiki Outpost, Third Sea.

item.name: Sky Adventurer
item.overview: The Sky Adventurer is located at the island above the Dark Masters in Skylands.

item.name: Sky Bandit
item.overview: The Sky Bandits have spiky blue hair and a headband that resembles a ninja's. They have wings sprouting from their back and wear a short-sleeve, open-collar suit with white pants. On their necks, they wear multiple jewelry items.

item.name: Sky Quest Giver 2
item.overview: The Sky Quest Giver 2 can be found at the second area of the Upper Skylands, under a tree.

item.name: Smoke Admiral
item.overview: The Smoke Admiral has blue hair, wears a blue shirt with black pants and brown shoes with the Coat on his back.

item.name: Snow Bandit
item.overview: The Snow Bandits wear a brown, white and blue shirt and pants and also have blue hair and use the Don't Wake Me Up Face.

item.name: Snow Demon
item.overview: The Snow Demons can be found at Candy Cane Land, Sea of Treats, Third Sea.

item.name: Snow Lurker
item.overview: The Snow Lurkers wear a black and blue puffy coat vest, black shirt, black pants with blue, decorated knee-pads, and black and white shoes. They also sport a black parka hood with a white fur lining, black balaclava, and Aura on their fists.

item.name: Snow Quest Giver
item.overview: The Snow Quest Giver is located at the left side of Snow Mountain, near the bridge.

item.name: Snow Trooper
item.overview: The Snow Troopers wears blue and black pants with a black vest and a gray t-shirt with torn black gloves on his hands and gray and white hair, they wear the Don't Wake Me Up face.

item.name: Snowman
item.overview: The Snowmans are sentient snowmans with root-like stick legs and arms, a scary face, and ice horns. They wear a scarf and some buttons on their chest, with some bits of frozen ice scattered around their body.

item.name: Sorcerer
item.overview: The Sorcerers wear a grey mask and a green shirt without sleeves, making it possible to see their muscular arms. In addition to this, they are clothed in black pants and gray shoes.

item.name: Soul Reaper
item.overview: "An unknown being has entered this world..."

item.name: Spy
item.overview: If the player gives the spy 1,500, the player can bribe the Spy. To fully bribe the Spy, the player will need four bribes for a total of 6,000. Once qualified, it will increase the chance of Frozen Dimension spawning.

item.name: Statue
item.overview: The Statue is located at the Trial of Flames, Prehistoric Island.

item.name: Stone
item.overview: Stone wears a white shirt with a pink belt and bright blue pants with brown shoes and blue hair. He also uses the Mildly Irritated Face.

item.name: Submarine Worker
item.overview: The Submarine Worker can be found behind the submarine at Tiki Outpost, near the Sun-kissed Warriors and below the spawn of Tyrant of the Skies.

item.name: Submerged Quest Giver 1
item.overview: The Submerged Quest Giver 1 can be found on the right side of the Submerged Island, in front of a orange coral among the Coral Pirates.

item.name: Submerged Quest Giver 2
item.overview: The Submerged Quest Giver 2 can be found in the middle of the Submerged Island, on a pile of sand.

item.name: Submerged Quest Giver 3
item.overview: The Submerged Quest Giver 3 can be found far south of the Submerged Island, on a some stone.

item.name: Summer Gacha
item.overview: The Summer Gacha was a limited-time NPC introduced during the Summer Event. It allows the player to purchase a random physical Blox Fruit in exchange for 500 Summer Tokens.

item.name: Sun-kissed Warrior
item.overview: The Sun-kissed Warriors can be found at Tiki Outpost, Third Sea.

item.name: Swan
item.overview: The Swan wears a uniquely styled black and red shirt with crimson red sunglasses. He has black hair, and wears the Pink Coat on his back.

item.name: Swan Pirate
item.overview: The Swan Pirates wear a coat that exposes their muscles, brown pants, and have red hair along with a Mildly Irritated Face.

item.name: Sweet Crafter
item.overview: The Sweet Crafter is located near the center of Chocolate Land, the sub-island of Sea of Treats, Third Sea.

item.name: Sweet Thief
item.overview: The Sweet Thiefs are located at Chocolate Land, Sea of Treats, close to the quest giver.

item.name: Sword Dealer
item.overview: The Sword Dealer can be found on both the Pirate and Marine starter islands.

item.name: Sword Dealer of the East
item.overview: The Sword Dealer of the East is a Shop NPC.

item.name: Sword Dealer of the West
item.overview: The Sword Dealer of the West can be found in the Pirate Village, behind the Pirates.

item.name: Tacomura
item.overview: Tacomura is located in the Castle on the Sea, near the stairs where the Barista Cousin sometimes appears, in the Third Sea.

item.name: Terrorshark
item.overview: The Terrorshark has a chance to spawn between Sea Danger Levels 2-6. When spawned, it will swim around the player(s) boat and constantly attack the player(s) until the boat/target dies. As the Sea Danger Level increases, the Terrorshark will progressively get stronger and harder to defeat. It is recommended to not go past Danger Level 5 as the Terrorsharks that spawn there are very powerful. Although higher levels do not increase health, they will carry more sharks and do greater damage. It is also almost impossible to escape from the Terrorshark, however fast fruits, such as Light, and boats, such as The Sentinel can sometimes outrun them.

item.name: The Gorilla King
item.overview: The Gorilla King resembles Gorillas, but bigger. There are certain distinguishing features, such as the crown on its head, its different skin color and the Aura that covers its hands.

item.name: The Mayor
item.overview: The Mayor is located in front of a house near the Military Soldiers.

item.name: The Saw
item.overview: "The Saw has spawned in the game! You have 15 minutes to kill him and possibly get a rare reward!"

item.name: The Strongest God
item.overview: The Strongest God be found in the Second Sea on Remote Island.

item.name: Thunder God
item.overview: The Thunder God wears brown, white, and blue pants with a blue ribbon and has the Tomoe Ring on his back. Despite this, he does not drop the Tomoe Ring.

item.name: Thunder God (NPC)
item.overview: The Thunder God was found at the Mini Sky Island, which was accessible after completing a Rumble Raid with the requirements below. The island can still be reached by flying above the Kingdom of Rose in the Second Sea, far away from all islands in the Third Sea. However, the player cannot purchase Pole (2nd Form) even if all requirements are met ever since after Update 27.

item.name: Tide Keeper
item.overview: The Tide Keeper wears green pants with a green ribbon, golden skeletons on his shoulders, yellow shoes with green hair and the Dont Wake Me Up face.

item.name: Tiki Quest Giver 1
item.overview: The Tiki Quest Giver 1 can be found in the right side of Tiki Outpost, in front of a building between the Isle Outlaws and Island Boys.

item.name: Tiki Quest Giver 2
item.overview: The Tiki Quest Giver 2 can be found in the left side of Tiki Outpost, in front of a building between the Sun-kissed Warriors and Isle Champions.

item.name: Tiki Quest Giver 3
item.overview: The Tiki Quest Giver 3 can be found in the left side of Tiki Outpost, on top of a wooden platform among the Serpent Hunters and Skull Slayers.

item.name: Titles Specialist
item.overview: The Titles Specialist is located in the Café (Second Sea). The player needs to head to the left side and pick up the silver chest in order to reveal the basement. They can then climb down the ladder and the Titles Specialist will be directly in front of them.

item.name: Toga Warrior
item.overview: The Toga Warriors wear red and white striped clothing with a white helmet, and the face they use is the Serious Scar Face.

item.name: Tort
item.overview: tort can be found in the Café and in the Turtle Mansion.

item.name: Tournament Master
item.overview: The Tournament Master could be found in the following places:

item.name: Trainee
item.overview: The Trainees have black hair and wear standard marine clothing. They also have the Serious Scar Face.

item.name: Training Dummy
item.overview: The Training Dummy is located behind the Arena Trainer.

item.name: Treasure Inventory
item.overview: The Treasure Inventory functioned similar to the Inventory, only allowing the player to store one fruit at a time, but could be upgraded with the Fruit Storage Gamepass. It could not store Materials, as they didn't exist around the time of this function.

item.name: Trevor
item.overview: Trevor offers the player to give him a physical fruit that has a value of 1,000,000 or higher in order to access Don Swan's room.

item.name: Trinket Expert
item.overview: The Trinket Expert is located in the Simulation Hub, standing beside the Trinket Refiner underneath the globe-like machinery nearby the Dungeons matchmaking area.

item.name: Trinket Refiner
item.overview: The Trinket Refiner is located in the Simulation Hub, besides the Trinket Expert underneath the globe-like machinery nearby the Dungeons matchmaking area.

item.name: Turtle Adventure Quest Giver
item.overview: The Turtle Adventure Quest Giver can be found near the main gate of the Floating Turtle, near the Fishman Raiders and Fishman Captains.

item.name: Tyrant of the Skies
item.overview: The Tyrant of the Skies has a muscular build alongside brown spikey hair, a red vest, blue and gold shorts as well as black boots. He also wields the Flail, a golden bird-like helmet (Feathered Visage), and tribal tattoos. The Tyrant's massive wings are red, yellow and blue with glowing stripes.

item.name: Unbound Werewolf
item.overview: The Unbound Werewolf was located at the Observatory.

item.name: Urban
item.overview: Urban can spawn in various places in the Third Sea, all spawn locations can be found here.

item.name: Uzoth
item.overview: Uzoth is an NPC in the Third Sea who teaches and upgrades Dragon Talon, which is the V2 form of Dragon Breath.

item.name: Valentines Delivery (NPC)
item.overview: This NPC was added during the 2026 Valentines Event on Feburary 14, 2026. This was a limited time event NPC and got removed prior to the event ending.

item.name: Valentines Gacha Dealer
item.overview: The Valentines Gacha Dealer was an limited-time event NPC.

item.name: Vampire
item.overview: The Vampires wear a dark vampire costume with black hair and the Classic Vampire Face.

item.name: Venomous Assailant
item.overview: The Venomous Assailants are clad in entirely black attire, accented by minimal purple detailing and a dark gray sash encircling the waist. A black mask conceals the lower half of their face, while a black conical hat is worn atop the head.

item.name: Vice Admiral
item.overview: The Vice Admiral wears a white and red shirt which is open, black and white pants with red shoes, along with the Coat on his back. He has dark toned blue hair, and wields the Triple Katana upon encounter.

item.name: Villager
item.overview: The Villager is located beside a house near the Snow Bandits.

item.name: Warden
item.overview: The Warden sports a black bodysuit that covers his chest and legs, along with several metal plates and black bands on his torso, ankle and shoulders. He has well-defined muscles on his arms and wears a black helmet with blue horns on it.

item.name: Water Fighter
item.overview: The Water Fighters wear a purple and black t-shirt with black pants and shorts with a purple and black hat with purple and black wings, they wear the Sigmund face.

item.name: Water Kung-fu Teacher
item.overview: The Water Kung-fu Teacher is located at the Underwater City, behind the palace, directly to its right. He is inside the part of the wall with a slight color difference. To get inside, the player can go on the left of the wall. The Water Kung-fu Teacher can also be found at Hot and Cold and the Castle on the Sea. There is no level requirement to talk to him or purchase the fighting style.
item.location: Underwater CityHot and ColdCastle on the Sea

item.name: Weapon Dealer
item.overview: The Weapon Dealer is located near the fountain at the center of Middle Town, in the First Sea.

item.name: Weird Machine
item.overview: The Weird Machine is located in the basement near the machine opposite the entrance to the downstairs in the Haunted Castle. Players who have not completed the Skull Guitar Puzzle yet will not be able to see the Weird Machine.

item.name: Wenlocktoad Over Heaven
item.overview: When talked to, Wenlocktoad Over Heaven's name would display as "KING WENLOCKTOAD-SAMA OVER HEAVEN" in the dialogue window.

item.name: Winter Gacha
item.overview: The Winter Gacha offered players limited-time event items as well as random Blox Fruits at the cost of 100 Candies. The cooldown for one roll is 2 hours, and the cooldown was shared with the Random Fruit gacha.

item.name: Winter Warrior
item.overview: The Winter Warriors wear a dirty white t-shirt with dirty black and yellow pants and gloves with a visor that covers their eyes and red hair.

item.name: Witch
item.overview: The Witch could have been found at the center of the Middle Town, inside of the Café and outside of the Mansion in the First, Second, and Third Seas respectively.

item.name: Wysper
item.overview: Wysper wears a grey neck accessory with red sleeves as well as pink shorts with white ends, along with brown hair shaved on the sides. He uses the Furious George Face.

item.name: Yeti (Boss)
item.overview: The Yeti is a reskin of The Gorilla King boss. However, it does not have the same six-pack of the latter, and uses a different head model. It is covered from head to toe in whitish-blue fur, with flatter, ice-like surfaces on its hands and feet. On its face is a large, flat nose, white eyes with red tints and a large, open mouth with large and sharp teeth. It has fluffy hair and a long, mane-like beard appearing on both his head and neck.

item.name: Yoshi
item.overview: Yoshi can be found on the left side of the roof of the castle on the second island of Skylands.

item.name: Zero
item.overview: Zero is located on the 20th floor of a dungeon, specifically on Hard mode. He is typically the last boss you fight before the dungeon ends and you can claim your rewards (unless you're doing Challenge difficulty).

item.name: Zombie
item.overview: The Zombies wear an emerald-green, tattered shirt, and black, mud-stained, torn jeans with loose fibers hanging over the holes. They have black, spiky hair, monstrous faces, and light green skin.
